data.body: Phase 2 analysts converged that permission-waiting and waiting-for-queen are not first-class runtime states. allComplete can declare success on blocked workers because blocked/waiting workers collapse into idle or settled categories. This is a 0bb4 acceptance blocker even though the broader communication design remains in hive-flow-2ee8.
data.title: P2-SH2 add first-class permission and queen waiting states
